Specification: This module specifies the Slush protocol, a simple consensus algorithm from the Avalanche family, using a PlusCal algorithm translated into TLA+. The model captures nodes that hold colors, loop processes that repeatedly query sampled peers, query processes that answer with their current color, and a client process that initially assigns colors to uncolored nodes. The comments explicitly note that the protocol is probabilistic in intent, but the TLA+ model is not probabilistic and is therefore mainly useful as executable pseudocode plus basic temporal checking. The specification defines an initial state, a next-state relation over the translated PlusCal control flow, a type invariant, and a temporal termination property asserting eventual completion of all processes. It also includes an explicit terminating stuttering action to avoid deadlock once all processes reach the Done control state.
AssumptionNames:
/\ Cardinality(Node) = Cardinality(SlushLoopProcess)
  /\ Cardinality(Node) = Cardinality(SlushQueryProcess)
  /\ SlushIterationCount \in Nat
  /\ SampleSetSize \in Nat
  /\ PickFlipThreshold \in Nat
IfThenElse: IF ~Terminate THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "WaitForQueryMessageOrTermination"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "Done"]
IF Terminate THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "QueryReplyLoop"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "RespondToQueryMessage"]
IF Pick(self) = NoColor THEN msg.color ELSE Pick(self)
IF loopVariant[self] < SlushIterationCount THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "QuerySampleSet"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "SlushLoopTermination"]

IF redTally >= PickFlipThreshold THEN /\ pick' = [pick EXCEPT ![HostOf[self]] = Red] ELSE /\ IF blueTally >= PickFlipThreshold THEN /\ pick' = [pick EXCEPT ![HostOf[self]] = Blue] ELSE /\ TRUE /\ pick' = pick
IF blueTally >= PickFlipThreshold THEN /\ pick' = [pick EXCEPT ![HostOf[self]] = Blue] ELSE /\ TRUE /\ pick' = pick
IF \E n \in Node : pick[n] = NoColor THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT !["ClientRequest"] = "AssignColorToNode"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT !["ClientRequest"] = "Done"]
IF pick[node] = NoColor THEN /\ pick' = [pick EXCEPT ![node] = color] ELSE /\ TRUE /\ pick' = pick

CASE self \in SlushQueryProcess -> "QueryReplyLoop"
